    Docs/Connector.sln/Connector.Infrastructure/src-Connector.Infrastructure-DataSources-ServiceNow
    Module

    src/Connector.Infrastructure/DataSources/ServiceNow

    Layer infrastructure · project Connector.Infrastructure · Options: 1

    Project navigation: Connector.Infrastructure

    Overview 🤖

    Manages interactions with ServiceNow's Table API, providing a layer for reading data and compiling queries.

    Responsibilities. Handles HTTP requests to ServiceNow, parses responses, and compiles queries into ServiceNow's encoded-query syntax.

    Usage. Used by the data source provider to fetch data from ServiceNow and compile queries for execution.

    AI draft from the facts on this page; review it, then write the module's documentation yourself.

    Key components

    Component Kind Used by Summary
    ServiceNowTableRequest record 3 One Table API read: the table, its sysparm_query (ServiceNow encoded query) and the sysparm_fields projection.
    ServiceNowClient class 2 The only code that talks HTTP to ServiceNow: authenticated, paginated GET /api/now/table/ reads over HTTPS. Everything above it (ServiceNowSchemaReader, ServiceNowTableApiProvider) sees records as string dictionaries. Retries only transient failures (429/502/503) a bounded number of times; maps every other failure to a DataSourceQueryException whose message never contains the credentials (they only ever travel in the Authorization header).
    ServiceNowQueryCompiler class 2 Compiles the database-neutral SourceQuery into Table API reads. ServiceNow's encoded-query syntax exists only here — never in Connector.Core or stored configuration. Validates against the schema first (SourceQueryValidator), so every field name is one ServiceNow reported; every value is checked for the encoded-query separators (^, and , inside IN) and rejected rather than escaped, so a value can never add a condition of its own. Conditions are sent server-side as the filter of the table they belong to; the Table API can't join, so joins become a second read keyed by the parent rows' values (see ServiceNowTableApiProvider).
    DictionaryRecord record 1
    ServiceNowClientOptions options 1 Tuning knobs for ServiceNowClient; the defaults are what production uses, tests shrink the delays.
    ServiceNowJoinStep record 1 A QueryJoin resolved in C#: Request reads the joined table (filtered by its own conditions, if any), and its rows are matched on Join.Column = ParentTable.ParentColumn.
    ServiceNowOutputColumn record 1 An output column of the result: which table's field, under which name.
    ServiceNowQueryPlan record 1 A compiled SourceQuery: a root read, joins resolved in C#, the output columns, and the limit (applied to the root read directly when no inner join can drop root rows).

    class · ServiceNowQueryCompiler.cs

    Compiles the database-neutral SourceQuery into Table API reads. ServiceNow's encoded-query syntax exists only here — never in Connector.Core or stored configuration. Validates against the schema first (SourceQueryValidator), so every field name is one ServiceNow reported; every value is checked for the encoded-query separators (^, and , inside IN) and rejected rather than escaped, so a value can never add a condition of its own. Conditions are sent server-side as the filter of the table they belong to; the Table API can't join, so joins become a second read keyed by the parent rows' values (see ServiceNowTableApiProvider).

    ServiceNowSchemaReader

    class · ServiceNowSchemaReader.cs

    Reads ServiceNow's table/field metadata through the ordinary Table API — sys_db_object (tables and their super_class inheritance) and sys_dictionary (fields) — into the same SourceSchema shape the SQL providers return. Needs read access to those two tables (e.g. the personalize_dictionary role), not admin; like every Table API read, the result only contains what the account's ACLs allow.

    Reached from: POST /api/connection, POST /api/import-definitions, PUT /api/import-definitions/{id:int}, GET /api/source-schema

    ServiceNowTableApiProvider

    class · ServiceNowTableApiProvider.cs

    The IDataSourceProvider for ServiceNowTableApi: ServiceNow read over its REST Table API, behind the same interface as the SQL providers — callers see SourceSchema, SourceQuery and QueryResult, never HTTP. Not an ISqlDataSourceProvider: there is no SQL to run, so ExecuteNativeAsync and the SQL-rendering export builders refuse it with UnsupportedDataSourceException.

    ExecuteAsync(Connector.Core.DataSources.DataSourceConfig, Connector.Core.DataSources.SourceQuery, System.Threading.CancellationToken) Validates query against the data source's live schema (SourceQueryValidator), compiles it into the provider's own dialect with every filter value bound as a parameter, executes it, and returns its rows generically. Throws InvalidSourceQueryException — before touching any data — for an unknown table/column or a malformed query; an execution failure the caller needs to inspect surfaces as DataSourceQueryException. 5
    ExecuteNativeAsync(Connector.Core.DataSources.DataSourceConfig, Connector.Core.DataSources.NativeSqlQuery, System.Threading.CancellationToken) Executes caller-built, provider-native SQL as-is and returns its rows generically — the path DynamicExportService's JSON-tree builders still use for what SourceQuery cannot express yet (knowledge/architecture/source-query-model.md §5). Same error contract as ExecuteAsync, minus schema validation. 1
